room.square.title: Square
room.square.description: A cobbled square. The market lies north; the watch house cell lies east.
room.market.title: Market
room.market.description: Stalls and shouting. The square lies south.
room.cell.title: Cell
room.cell.description: A cold cell in the watch house. A barred door leads west to the square.
npc.crier.description: A loud man with a bell.
npc.ada.description: A tall walker with a staff.
npc.guard.description: A guard in the watch's colours.
npc.guard.arrest: The guard takes your arm at the market gate and walks you to the cell.
dialogue.talk.prompt: They wait for you to speak.
narration.crier.confess: The crier cries your crime to the square.
npc.jailer.room: The [[jailer|jailer]] sits by the door with a ledger.
npc.jailer.description: A tired jailer with a ledger and a ring of keys.
trial.charge: The sergeant reads the charge aloud: wanted in the square. Pay the fine or sit.
dialogue.jailer.prompt: The jailer taps the ledger. "Five pennies, or you sit."
narration.jailer.paid: The jailer counts five pennies, strikes your name from the ledger and unbars the door.
narration.jailer.sentence: The jailer shrugs. "Then you sit until the fine is paid."
